reason: I do trust the creator, but I've never heard of Claro and nothing here tells me what the filter actually removes. Nearly $68 up front plus a subscription for something I'd mainly use on a few trips a year is a lot to put on an unknown brand.
objection: It might be a generic white-label bottle with a new logo on it. 'The supplier rates it at 150 L' isn't independent testing, and I don't want to be stuck in a filter subscription for a knockoff.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing independent lab or certification results for what the filter removes, plus the creator actually using it on camera while travelling for a few weeks, would get me to try the single-filter plan.
